question: On the CoinDesk Data (CryptoCompare) Personal plan, is a numeric free monthly or lifetime call quota stated on a first-party page, or only the qualitative prose 'Capped lifetime calls'?
why: On 2026-11-19 the first-party pricing page developers.coindesk.com/pricing no longer served its plan card (404 shell / redirect to a contact page); the 'Capped lifetime calls' prose survives only in cached copies, not in a page capturable today. The first-party retirement notice of 21 May 2026 remains capturable and confirms the free tier ended. Third-party pages cite a 250,000 lifetime-call figure, but that is not a first-party statement and was not proposed as a value.
